contraction_scope: Floating diagnostic only. In the exact trained Markov model, identical t-bit suffixes contract one-view endpoint absolute probability differences by delta_max^t and a product of four likelihoods by at most4delta_max^t; not a posterior, true-EC-dynamics or security bound.
construction_counter_scope: Incremental feature setup and training; public Tonelli nonresidue cache may be reused from earlier features. Sum all fixture kernels for total setup.
payload_size_scope: Trained probabilities, raw training counts and row masses only; excludes calibration, marginals, objects, allocator overhead and temporary matrices.
public_sampler: balanced finite roots plus identity1/N then cofactor projection; Tonelli-Shanks; no scalar labels
model_assumption: Uniform rerandomized one-time marginals do not imply an exact hidden-state Markov law or independent views
